player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I did not check the inventory before attempting to place the banana in the freezer. I assumed the banana was still in my inventory after putting it there, but the game state likely reset or I misinterpreted the "already in inventory" feedback from a previous attempt. Next time, after placing an item in its target location, I will explicitly verify the inventory list to ensure the item is no longer held before trying to place another item. I will also ensure I visit the pantry and open the freezer immediately after acquiring the banana to avoid unnecessary backtracking.
